description: Install, check or remove the playbook guard hooks: deterministic guards that stop a coding agent from skipping git hooks, committing secrets, adding attribution lines or non-Conventional commit subjects, loosening lint config, or committing straight to the default branch, plus a typecheck when the agent stops. Use on request only: "install the guard hooks", "set up the guards", "why was my commit blocked by a playbook guard", "turn off a guard", "remove the guard hooks". Works in Claude Code and Codex.
